summary:
Comprehensive architectural and phased implementation plan for Jai Jinendra Grocery Mart in Jaora, MP, India.
Includes full bilingual (English/Hindi) e-commerce storefront, 50 pre-seeded local grocery products, atomic order management, Cash on Delivery & Demo UPI/QR payment flows, secure order tracking, protected role-based admin dashboard with 14 management sections, live activity stream, immutable audit logging, safe AI assistant with human-in-the-loop approval workflow, and comprehensive test suite.
